solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Plunged scoundrel into lawsuit against daughter

indicators.note: into says the scoundrel's word goes inside the lawsuit's word

parts.note: a case is a lawsuit brought before a court
a cad is a dishonourable man, a scoundrel

explanation.surface: Someone sank a rogue into litigation brought against their own daughter.
explanation.definitionFit: Water that cascaded fell steeply in a rush, as a plunged stream does.

clue.text: Indicator of Cockney part of London

definitions.meaning: a pointer on a sign showing the way to go
Harrow, a district of north-west London, said with the Cockney dropped H

explanation.surface: A sign pointing to some East End district of the capital.
explanation.walkthrough: Cockneys, working-class Londoners, famously drop their initial H, so HARROW, a London borough, becomes 'ARROW.
explanation.definitionFit: A drawn pointer is the commonest indicator of direction on signs and maps.

clue.text: Indian meal for tea in Guildford with Spooner

indicators.note: Spooner names the reverend whose slips swapped the opening sounds of two words

parts.note: Guildford is the county town of Surrey, an English county south of London
a cuppa is British slang for a cup of tea

explanation.surface: An evening of Indian food in a Surrey town shared with a famous Oxford don.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the first sounds of SURREY CUPPA gives something said like CURRY SUPPA, spelt CURRY SUPPER.
explanation.definitionFit: A supper of curry is an evening dish from the cooking of India.

clue.text: Waste long periods in prisons

parts.note: dung is animal waste
eons are vast stretches of time

explanation.surface: Wasting years and years locked up in jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Dungeons were underground cells in castles where captives were held.

clue.text: Intensities of rapes I'd suffered led to utter hopelessness

parts.note: the depths of a feeling are its most intense points
taken as written

indicators.note: suffered signals that the letters were damaged into a new order

explanation.surface: A grim account of a victim's ordeal leading to total despondency.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes the lowest point of misery, where all hope has gone.

clue.text: Centre of storms blew off hat

indicators.note: off signals that the letters go wrong and are rearranged
Centre of picks the two central letters of the word storms

explanation.surface: In the middle of a gale a hat was blown away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Centre of storms' gives OR; 'off' tells you to shuffle OR with BLEW.
explanation.definitionFit: A bowler is a hard round felt hat, the classic City gent's headwear.

clue.text: Dazed by idol in the flesh

indicators.note: Dazed suggests the letters are muddled and scrambled

explanation.surface: A fan stunned at meeting a hero in person.
explanation.definitionFit: Bodily means physically, in person, as in appearing in the flesh.

clue.text: Chinese speciality not currently served up

indicators.note: in a down clue served up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: not now means not at this moment

explanation.surface: A Chinese restaurant dish that is off the menu just now.
explanation.definitionFit: Wonton dumplings are a well-known Chinese dish.

clue.text: Being a divorcee, I catch son returning by chance finally

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse

indicators.note: in a down clue returning means the word goes back up the grid

parts.note: a net is a catch, a haul of fish

indicators.note: finally takes the closing letters of the word chance

explanation.surface: A divorced parent happens to catch their son coming home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns NET into TEN; 'finally' takes the last two letters of 'chance', CE.
explanation.definitionFit: Being as a noun means life or presence, the state of being alive or real.

clue.text: Need a drink to manage test

parts.note: someone dry is thirsty
to run a business is to manage it

explanation.surface: A thirsty person must handle an exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A dry run is a rehearsal or trial before the real thing.

clue.text: Punctilious journalist in a flap about Times leader

indicators.note: in places the journalist inside the flap
about says the flap goes round the leader of Times

parts.note: a flap is a state of panic

indicators.note: leader takes the first letter of the word Times

parts.note: ED, short for editor, is the crossword journalist

explanation.surface: A fussy reporter gets flustered over the newspaper's editorial.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times leader' sounds like a newspaper editorial, but it is just T.
explanation.definitionFit: A pedantic person is overly concerned with minor details and rules, just as a punctilious one is.

clue.text: Persuade state to accept introduction of wiretapping

indicators.note: to accept means the word for state takes the letter inside it

parts.note: to state is to say

indicators.note: introduction of takes the first letter of wiretapping

explanation.surface: Convince the government to allow phone bugging.
explanation.walkthrough: 'state' looks like a noun (a nation) but is the verb SAY.
explanation.definitionFit: To sway someone is to influence or win them over to a view.

clue.text: Cheer up, cook, relax and eat Thai — no thanks

indicators.note: to cook figures or food is to work them over, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: ta is informal British for thanks

explanation.surface: Instructions to lift one's mood: make dinner, unwind and refuse a Thai meal politely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'no thanks' means TA is left out: the letters of RELAX and EAT THAI less T and A are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhilarate is to make someone lively and elated, raising their spirits.

clue.text: Troops in the position of 6 across and 23 down, say

definitions.meaning: ordinary soldiers as distinct from officers

definitions.text: in the position of 6 across and 23 down, say
definitions.meaning: an across entry sits in a rank (row) and a down entry in a file (column) of the grid

explanation.surface: Soldiers lined up where two particular entries of the grid sit.
explanation.walkthrough: 6 across lies along a row, a rank; 23 down along a column, a file.
explanation.definitionFit: Rank and file means the ordinary members of a body, originally the private soldiers.

clue.text: Rejoin revolution after army corps starts to take over

indicators.note: after puts the revolution behind the army corps

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
a turn is one revolution

indicators.note: starts to takes the first letters of the next two words

explanation.surface: An uprising follows as army units begin a coup.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolution' suggests a coup, but it is just TURN, a rotation.
explanation.definitionFit: To return to a group or topic is to come back and rejoin it.

clue.text: Extremely idiotic to stand by the corrupt partner honourably

indicators.note: corrupt means the word the is spoiled into a new order
Extremely takes the outer letters of idiotic

parts.note: an ally is a partner

explanation.surface: It is stupid to back a crooked associate in the name of honour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the corrupt' gives ETH, an anagram of THE; 'to stand by' only links.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting ethically means acting by moral principles, decently and with integrity.

clue.text: No amount included in promotion on eBay

indicators.note: included in says the answer sits inside the following words

explanation.surface: Nothing was charged as part of an online sale.
explanation.definitionFit: None means not any, zero quantity of something.

clue.text: Those chosen include Tory I initially considered as broadminded

indicators.note: include means the chosen word holds the Tory inside it

parts.note: the elect are those chosen
C is the abbreviation for Conservative, a Tory

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of considered

explanation.surface: Elected members including a Conservative were deemed tolerant.
explanation.definitionFit: Eclectic tastes draw from many sources, showing an open and wide-ranging outlook.

clue.text: First of winter fruit crop perhaps

indicators.note: First of takes the opening letter of winter

parts.note: a hip is the fruit of the rose

explanation.surface: The earliest fruit harvest of the winter season.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crop' looks like a harvest, but it is the rider's short whip.
explanation.definitionFit: A riding crop is one kind of whip, so 'perhaps' marks an example.

clue.text: Died last month freed from pain

parts.note: Dec, December, is the last month of the year
eased means relieved of pain

explanation.surface: Someone passed away last month, at last free of suffering.
explanation.definitionFit: Deceased is an adjective meaning dead, so it can stand for died in that sense.

clue.text: Eid to become extinct?

parts.note: the letters of the word die, put out of order, make Eid

explanation.surface: Asking whether a Muslim festival might vanish altogether.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as instructions: DIE OUT, the word die shuffled, gives EID.
explanation.definitionFit: A species that dies out disappears completely, ceasing to exist.

clue.text: Misguided racists take legal action as a result of old wounds

indicators.note: Misguided suggests the letters have gone astray into a new order

parts.note: to sue is to take legal action

explanation.surface: Bigots go to court over injuries they caused long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Healed injuries leave fibrous marks on the skin, the lasting trace of a cut.

clue.text: Puritan drops publicity for dead guy

indicators.note: drops says the publicity letters are lost from the puritan
for says the dead letter takes their place

parts.note: a prude is a puritanical person
PR is public relations, publicity

explanation.surface: A strait-laced man gives up spin in favour of a dead fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: Dude is American slang for a man or fellow.

clue.text: Start of French objection

parts.note: de is French for of
a but is an objection, as in no ifs or buts

explanation.surface: The opening of a French protest.
explanation.definitionFit: A debut is a first appearance, the beginning of a career.

clue.text: A large number appeal about unauthorised centre

indicators.note: about says the appeal goes round the central letters

parts.note: a plea is an appeal

indicators.note: centre takes the middle four letters of unauthorised

explanation.surface: Many people are petitioning over an illegal facility.
explanation.definitionFit: A plethora is an excess or great abundance of something.

clue.text: See 7
Only part of the truth is bearable for ill-fated lover

indicators.note: Only part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Only a fraction of reality can be endured.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft put 'for' in the definition; it is only a link word joining wordplay to definition, so the definition is 'ill-fated lover'.
explanation.definitionFit: Thisbe is Pyramus's beloved in Ovid's tragic tale, who dies after a misunderstanding.

clue.text: Young bird which sounds like a seal

indicators.note: which sounds like says the word is said aloud as another

parts.note: a signet is a seal, as on a ring

explanation.surface: A baby bird whose call resembles a seal's bark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seal' suggests the animal, but it is the stamp on a signet ring.
explanation.definitionFit: A juvenile swan is called a cygnet.

clue.text: About to bring to life design again

parts.note: re means about, concerning
to create is to bring into being

explanation.surface: Ready to revive a pattern drawn up once more.
explanation.definitionFit: To recreate is to make or devise something anew.
